answer: Locks are written down in vine, expire in nadir, and ocean lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 101 aliases as a result needs 81 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4562 identities would post 3409 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
